title: Liposome nanoparticles with photothermal effect for the treatment of bacterial infectious periodontitis
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,394-408
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA08225K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Juan Zhang, Qing Yang, Cailing Zhao, Shisheng Cao, Meng Xia, Xingtong Mu, Huijuan Yin
AIE-based liposomal nanoparticles (2TT-oC6B@LIP) were developed as NIR-triggered photothermal agents to eradicate periodontal pathogens and biofilms, effectively alleviating periodontitis progression.
